newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 678.94 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 678.94 mln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said it had auctioned on Tuesday three-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds worth a total of 678.94 million rupees.

The bank said it accepted bids worth 80.39 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds and 598.55 million for 10-year bonds. No bids were received for five-year bonds, which were also offered. The auction settlement is set for Thursday.
In the previous auction on September 26, the SBP accepted bids worth 100.30 million rupees for three-year bonds, 52.50 million for five-year and 104.175 million for 10-year bonds.
